text:
sam: Heads-up: starting 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC, new Private/VPC installers will default to local dataplane encryption ON (AES-256) and telemetry OFF. This affects only NEW installs and bundled on-prem packages.

lina: Clarify: local dataplane encryption means agent-hosted disk + inter-agent comms are encrypted using keys that can be customer-managed via KMS, correct?

sam: Correct. Default uses auto-generated keys stored in the agent keystore. Customers can set local_kms_enforced=true to force KMS-only keys.

raj_ops: Existing tenants? No silent changes I hope.

sam: No silent flips. Existing installs keep current settings for 120 days. We will notify admins and provide a migration CLI.

maria_legal: Legal note: the customer notice must state that telemetry is off by default and that request payloads are never collected unless explicitly consented. Also require retention terms in the notice.

deploy-bot: Job queued: onprem-default-encryption-rollout v1. CI: https://ci.internal/build/90012. Change window: 30m.

raj_ops: Ops to add: heartbeat + encryption-error alerts, and a dashboard to verify key rotation success. Also test KMS passthrough in staging tonight.

sam: CLI snippets for migration added to runbook. Example:
```
# enforce customer KMS for tenant
redwoodctl private update --tenant <TENANT_ID> --set local_kms_enforced=true
# opt-in telemetry (customer action)
redwoodctl agent telemetry opt-in --tenant <TENANT_ID> --consent-file consent.json
```

lina: GTM wants a short partner blurb. Will draft in #product-commms after legal signs off.

maria_legal: Approved with minor edits. Add console banner: "Encryption ON by default for new private installs. Telemetry disabled by default; enable to share anonymized metrics."

sam: Thanks everyone. Quick sign-off sync tomorrow 09:00 PT.
